title: Guitar (samples)
description: Plays recorded guitar notes from a sample set of the project as a strummed chord pattern. It needs a sample set and notes, and gives audio.

parameters.name: set
parameters.doc: A sample set (a folder of the project with note-named WAV files).

parameters.name: strum
parameters.doc: Sixteen strum steps per bar: D/d downstroke, U/u upstroke, x mute and . let ring; bars can be separated by |.

parameters.name: voicing
parameters.doc: Chord voicing: open, triad or power.

parameters.name: stagger
parameters.doc: Delay between successive strings in milliseconds.

parameters.name: humanize
parameters.doc: A little human feel for a sampled instrument: at 100 every note starts up to 6 ms early or late and up to 15 % louder or softer (deterministic from the seed). 0 plays exactly on the grid.

parameters.name: patterns
parameters.doc: Named strums, separated by /: name=strum, for example verse=D...D.u.D.u. / fill=DdDdDdDdDdDdDdDd. A song (the next parameter) puts them in order.

parameters.name: song
parameters.doc: The sections in order: a strum name with an optional number of bars, for example verse*4 fill chorus*8. The word pattern is the plain strum of the block. The sequence repeats when the block is longer. Empty: the plain strum plays.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: A sample set folder with recorded guitar notes (parameter set).
